name: FB Frame Counter
description: Practice recording, replay, and 240 Hz frame-window analysis.

sounds.name: Click sounds
sounds.description: Play a ding for measured inputs during playback. Scans stay silent.

max-counted-frames.name: Max circle frame
max-counted-frames.description: Hide click circles above this exact frame width. Counters, sounds and copied counts are unchanged.

counter-ranges.name: Counter rows
counter-ranges.description: Use comma-separated frame numbers or ranges, such as 1,2,3,7-8.
